import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns
from sklearn.datasets import load_iris
from sklearn.decomposition import PCA

# Load the iris dataset
iris = load_iris()
df = pd.DataFrame(data=iris.data, columns=iris.feature_names)
df['species'] = iris.target_names[iris.target]

# Reduce dimensionality to 2D using PCA
pca = PCA(n_components=2)
pca_data = pca.fit_transform(df.drop('species', axis=1))

# Create a DataFrame with the reduced data
pca_df = pd.DataFrame(data=pca_data, columns=['Principal Component 1', 'Principal Component 2'])
pca_df['species'] = df['species']

# Map species to a numerical value
species_map = {'setosa': 0, 'versicolor': 1, 'virginica': 2}
pca_df['species'] = pca_df['species'].map(species_map)

# Plot the data using seaborn
plt.figure(figsize=(8, 6))
sns.scatterplot(x='Principal Component 1', y='Principal Component 2', hue='species', data=pca_df)
plt.title('Iris Dataset Visualization')
plt.savefig('output.png')
